steps.content: [Black Screen]
The illusion is gone, completely.
Hilda stands before you once more.
[Contamination CG - Animated]

Mania has morphed into cruel shackles around her body, concealing the scar on her throat. Her long hair is plastered to a face and neck as pale as marble. Her eyes—once so piercing, so deeply knowing—are now vacant, like wells that have long run dry.
Yet, as her gaze finds you—you, who have returned to this desperate place, who have fought so hard to reach her—the ghost of a smile touches her lips.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Why... did you come back?

options: I told you I would help you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...You fool... This place is dangerous...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Mania could consume my consciousness completely at any moment. Soon, even this last sanctuary will be thoroughly corrupted.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: When that happens... not even those "memories" will be able to guide you.
She points at your body, and in response, specks of white light drift from you like luminous dust. They float through the air, settling upon her hand.
Wherever they land, the shackles binding her dissolve, melting away like snow under a warm sun.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...That time you were drinking tea in my room... you suddenly jumped up and said you could smell poison.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You tried to act casual, but your expression was so serious as you searched the entire room... and you actually found it.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You saved my life, and yet... I still doubted you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: When I received that letter from the metropoles... you discovered I had been using you, testing you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You said we were just two tools, thrown together by circumstance... walking different paths, yet choosing to stay.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I felt truly grateful.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: And then... you used The Wilderness to help us uncover the mole.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: The ideals of the past... they are both the key to the truth, and the witnesses to all that has happened.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Then, at the very end.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I entrusted everything to you... let you leave this place. To use my "corpse" and the "Monolith" to accomplish two tasks.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: As a result... I was tortured for years, then sealed for decades. I started out just waiting for death... but eventually, I only wanted one thing. An answer.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: But now that you're finally here... I find I'm no longer so fixated on that answer.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I just... really wanted to see you again. That's all...
Her hand rises from the mire of contamination, stretching toward you with painstaking caution.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...No matter what... thank you. Thank you for coming back for me.

You instinctively recoil half a step, evading her touch. Her fingertips hang suspended in the air for a fractured second before falling gently to her side. That faint smile still lingers on her lips, but now it's etched with a profound and quiet bitterness.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: It's alright... At least you did come.
Mania ripples, a slow, consuming tide that begins to swallow the last fragments of her form.
She has failed. She has struggled. She has never truly surrendered. And yet, you are the one who let go.
Perhaps it's a subconscious alarm bell, a primal instinct for self-preservation. Or maybe a colder, more rational conclusion, that even if she wakes, her existence will be nothing but agony.
You watch Mania claim her, and within you, there is only a vast, silent hollow.
Then, the world convulses. Waves of Mania erupt in a violent storm as corruption spreads like a plague. The very space around you groans, fracturing and beginning to implode.

Suddenly, from the churning mire before you, a figure forces its way into being. Mania has sculpted her new body—a silhouette of pure, volatile energy. She lurches forward, her arms, dripping with primordial filth, locking you in a desperate, crushing embrace.
Her fingers tremble against your back as scars of raw Mania spider-web across her skin.
And in the moment of that embrace, her whisper brushes against your ear—

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I gave you everything. My ideals, my trust. I waited... and you never came.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I told myself you must have had your reasons. But as the years turned, that waiting festered. Mania didn't just consume me... it became me.
Familiar howls twist with her whispers as her hands lock onto yours. Her fingertips are like ice, yet they burn with the last, lingering warmth of her obsession.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Now you're back... but it's too late. I don't believe you anymore.
Your foreheads touch.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...This time, I will see the truth for myself.
The contamination vanishes, giving way to a storm of code strips that rustle and sway around you.
Her grip tightens, a desperate vise, and a profound emptiness yawns open inside you.

Mania assails you from all sides, ripping through your being. Before your eyes, your very essence is torn away, transforming into countless intelligence strips. They unravel, merging with the air itself, converting into a tide of radio waves.
You finally realize it. She is using her power on you!
[Shackles]
You raise your hand to release your shackles, and a flickering red light erupts, piercing through your palms. But it is not enough. It cannot halt this desperate, all-or-nothing assault.
Your memories break free in a frantic flood, stripped bare and completely exposed to her ravenous power.
The world before you bleeds away. Only her voice remains—a gentle, yet unyielding echo, resonating in the depths of your mind like a whisper from the abyss itself.
(Mania effect transitions to red text)
<color=#fb9259>Since we met, we've been deciphering each other.</color>

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: So this is the real you—

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Hero of DisCity, Chief of Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, ${PlayerName}.
